L0.name: topological organization
L0.definition_a: P0(u) = (1/|Lambda|) * sum over the 0-dim persistence diagram of the superlevel filtration of (b - d)/du. Q0 = 1 - P0(u)/P0(null). Precondition sigma_u/du >= 0.01, else no verdict.

L1.name: characteristic scale in the scene's own metric
L1.definition_a: R(l) is the axis-averaged normalised autocorrelation of u; xi = min{ l : R(l) < exp(-1) } in cells. Q1 = xi/h. Precondition none.

L2.name: predictability, self-referenced
L2.definition_a: q2(u) = 1 - H(u|context)/H(u) with 16-level west and north neighbours; Q2 = (q2(u) - q2(null))/(1 - q2(null)). Precondition H(u) > 0.

L3.name: legibility through a declared observer
L3.definition_a: u_xi = DoG(u; sigma1 = xi/2, sigma2 = 2 xi); C_xi = std(u_xi)/mean(u); Q3 = log2(1 + C_xi * q / C_eye). Precondition xi/h >= 2, else no verdict. q is the declared channel factor.
